cohort: The study included 27,339,861 pregnancy-related hospitalizations captured in the Nationwide Inpatient Sample (NIS) between 2016 and 2022, identifying 36,310 Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) cases.
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) prevalence significantly increased by 2.9% annually between 2016 and 2022, and PAS was strongly associated with increased risks of severe maternal morbidity, hysterectomy, blood transfusion, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Prior cesarean delivery was strongly associated with Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), and rising cesarean delivery rates contributed to the increasing PAS prevalence.
